news.title: EVA Air Collaborates with AIT Worldwide Logistics, Microsoft and Formosa Petrochemical Corporation to Deliver 15,000 Metric Tons of Scope 3 Emissions Reductions
EVA Air and AIT Worldwide Logistics aim to cut 15,000 metric tons of carbon emissions in first year of green transportation program
EVA Air Partners with Microsoft, AIT on Green Transport Agreement; First-Year Carbon Reduction of 15,000 Tonnes
AIT Worldwide Logistics Welcomes Justin Kosslyn as Chief Digital and Technology Officer

summary: AIT Worldwide Logistics. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Chicago-based global freight forwarder with an Amsterdam office that is an IND recognised sponsor and currently lists an English-language entry-level data role.

culture.text: Describes itself as a global freight forwarder moving goods door to door by sea, air, road and rail for industries from aerospace to life sciences.
Headquartered in Chicago and in business for more than 40 years, with a consultative, technology-backed approach.

open.text: AIT Worldwide Logistics B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor, so it can sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa.
Its one open job here, an entry-level data role in Amsterdam, does not require Dutch.
That posting drew about 131 applicants on LinkedIn on average, so expect competition.

worth_knowing.text: Appointed Justin Kosslyn as Chief Digital and Technology Officer, relevant if you're aiming for its data and tech side.
Teamed up with EVA Air, Microsoft and Formosa Petrochemical on a green transport programme aiming to cut 15,000 metric tons of emissions.
